body.x: WYBOT, a global leader in innovative pool maintenance solutions, has introduced the WYBOT S3 Pool Cleaning Robot at CES 2025 in Las Vegas. This groundbreaking device redefines pool care with advanced autonomous features, including 3D mapping, self-emptying, automatic solar charging, and real-time underwater control. Designed to deliver hands-free maintenance for up to a month, the WYBOT S3 sets a new standard in convenience and sustainability.

“The WYBOT S3 Pool Cleaning Robot is the ultimate testament to WYBOT’s commitment to innovation and pool owner convenience,” said José Vallés, Vice President and General Manager of Americas at WYBOT. “With the integration of cutting-edge robotic technologies, the WYBOT S3 represents the pinnacle of innovation in the industry, offering pool owners a smarter, more efficient, and environmentally friendly way to maintain their pools.”

The WYBOT S3 introduces features that transform pool cleaning from a chore into an effortless experience. Using advanced 3D mapping technology, the robot creates a precise underwater map to plan the most efficient cleaning routes, ensuring full coverage, even in irregularly shaped pools. Its Smart Debris Management system includes the world’s first self-emptying feature for a robotic pool cleaner. Debris collected in the robot’s onboard bin is transferred to an above-ground base station, enabling up to eight cleaning cycles or 30 days of operation without user intervention.

body.x: Equipped with dual charging capabilities, the robot leverages solar-assisted charging for reduced energy consumption. Under optimal sunlight, the solar panel provides 1.5 hours of runtime after a single day of charging. Traditional DC charging ensures consistent performance in all weather conditions. The WYBOT S3 also features vision-aided debris detection, allowing it to prioritize heavily soiled areas, and real-time monitoring via Wi-Fi and sonar, enabling users to adjust settings and track progress through a mobile app.

The robot’s innovative technology ensures a sparkling, clean pool with minimal effort. Available for pre-order starting in Q2 2025, the WYBOT S3 Pool Cleaning Robot is priced at $2,999, with exclusive launch incentives for early adopters.

With its cutting-edge features and commitment to innovation, WYBOT continues to set benchmarks in robotic pool cleaning. It has earned accolades such as the 2025 CES Best of Innovation Award and the 2024 French, New York, and Paris Design Awards.
